svg.title: The DEV_OS development cycle on GitHub
svg.desc: A build loop runs for every task: fence, build with a read-only builder, verify on main's code, review; a FAIL reissues the fence, a usage limit waits and resumes, a PASS auto-merges into the unit. A ship loop runs for every unit: the acceptance pull request waits for you, your merge reaches main, it deploys, and the next unit starts.
